SRO- Haldwani, Jhilmil, Karnal, Rohtak, Udaipur, Kota, Noida

Subject: Implementation of CCPAP Module of Payment.

Sir,
CCPAP Module in the above said offices may be rolled out from 26.08.2014.

2. The above offices may generate digitally signed CCPAP advice file and
upload the same to SBI SFTP server on 25.08.2014. The file of 25.08.2014 should contain
the details of cheques issued from A/c No. 1 & 10 on 25.08.2014 and also for the period
preceding three months prior to 25.08.2014. Thereafter, the file may be uploaded on a
daily basis in respect of cheques issued in A/c No. 1 & 10.

3. After uploading the file SBI will fetch the file available in designated folder
of SFTP server and perform further activities. Any technical issue for roll out of CCPAP
may be taken with Shri D.K. Pandey, AGM, SBI & Nodal Officer for EPFO and Shri S.
K. Panda, DD(IS).

4. The concerned officials may be in readiness for sending the details of cheques
issued during the preceding three months prior to 25.08.2014 and thereafter on a daily
basis.

Yours faithfully,

(Sanjay Kumar)
Regional] P.F. Commissioner-I(F&A)
